title: Late-Correction Goodwill on Rate Lock Commitment Appraisal-Delay Waivers
content:
Late correction of an appraisal delay on a **Rate Lock Commitment** earns goodwill days. When Larkspur waives on its own initiative an extension charge that the appraisal-delay case covers, and only in such a waiver, it also bears late-correction goodwill days. These are added to the covered days of the extension. The covered days, these days included, are never below zero and never more than the extension's charged days.

The lateness is the calendar days from the date the appraisal report was completed, as shown on the **Appraisal Order**, to the date the waiver is booked.

**Rule.**

- When the waiver is booked more than **21** days (the long late-correction days) after the appraisal report was completed, the long late-correction goodwill of **2** days is added to the covered days.
- When it is booked more than **7** days (the late-correction days) but no more than 21 days after completion, the late-correction goodwill of **1** day is added.
- Otherwise none are added.

| Days from report completion to the waiver | Goodwill days |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 0 |
| 8 to 21 | 1 |
| 22 or more | 2 |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, report completed 1 March):* a waiver booked 8 March (7 days) adds nothing; one booked 9 March (8 days) adds 1 day. A waiver booked 22 March (21 days) adds 1 day; one booked 23 March (22 days) adds 2 days.
